doc: The five concrete samples of OpenSLO's website/docs/specification.md (its 8th, 14th, 16th, 18th and 19th yaml blocks), joined by --- into one stream in the order they appear: an SLO with an inline SLI reading from a data source by reference, an alert policy with an inline condition and a notification target by reference, a condition of the same name as a document of its own, and two notification targets. Two of the SLI's sources name the same data source, which is read once. The inline condition and the document condition share a name and keep apart, the inline one's id being its policy's with its own. The SLO names a service and a data source with no document in the stream, and nothing names the policy from an SLO: the diagram shows the first two as missing and reports the SLO as not alerting (User Story 3).
